Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Black and White Giraffe Portrait Photo Print Framed Wall Art Decor - 13 x 15 Inch Frame, Black
Colors: Black
A whimsical giraffe challenges you to a stare-down in this photo. The high quality, black and white giclee print will bring a striking touch of nature into your home. It arrives ready to hang in a black frame. 15"W x 13"H Black finish frame, paper and glass Modern print of an eye-catching nature subject Ready to hang, all hardware included
